product_findings.component: Harmonika TUI chat viewport (SGR mouse wheel handling)
product_findings.initial_claim: single wheel-down SGR tick appeared not to scroll the chat viewport
product_findings.audit_result: claim was a harness artifact: the smoke's MiniTerm emulator lacked DECSTBM scroll regions (CSI r), region-aware LF/RI/IND and ECH (CSI X); the app scrolls via ESC[4;24r + ESC M (up) / LF-at-region-bottom (down) plus single-row repaints, which MiniTerm dropped for the down direction
product_findings.evidence: raw escape stream shows one new bottom-row repaint per singleton down tick (marker 167 then 168 with only ~136 bytes emitted); after fixing MiniTerm, MiniTerm and the independent pyte emulator agree on every checkpoint and singleton down moves +1 line per tick until the list bottom clamps it
product_findings.product_verdict: wheel handling correct in both directions in the shipped frozen binary; no product defect
